articles.title: Why commercial rooftop solar is emerging as a key driver of India’s clean energy transition
articles.summary: Commercial and industrial consumers account for nearly 50% of India's electricity consumption, making energy one of their largest operating expenses. Rising electricity tariffs, coupled with increasing pressure to meet ESG commitments, are encouraging businesses to generate power where they consume it. Unlike conventional grid electricity, rooftop solar offers long-term cost certainty, helping organizations reduce exposure to fluctuating power prices while improving financial planning.

articles.title: 70-yr-old dispute finally settled; SC says 1950 is line that decides who owns Gurugram common land
articles.summary: The Supreme Court settled a 70-year-old dispute over ownership of 436 bighas of common land in Gurugram’s Haiderpur village. The top court restored a 1955 land record mutation, ruling that the Gram Panchayat Wazirabad (now Municipal Corporation of Gurugram) owns the land, as proprietors cannot claim common land as private property without proving a pre-1950 partition. The decision hinges on the 1950 land records as the decisive line for ownership claims.
articles.raw_summary: Top court restores 1955 mutation of 436 bighas in Haiderpur to Gram Panchayat Wazirabad, now MCG, ruling proprietors cannot claim common land as private property without proving pre-1950 partition.
